outcome: Stopped by the probe memory guard; not a completed 128-object bandwidth benchmark.
recommendation: Keep the main source pool at 64. This 128-request buffered probe reached its memory guard before completing and does not establish a throughput advantage or an isolated bandwidth plateau. Do not repeat this optional probe.

counterInterpretation.requests: NativeSource counter: fully successful response bodies only; 128 initial object requests were scheduled.
counterInterpretation.downloadedBytes: Bytes of fully completed successful response bodies; excludes bytes received from subsequently cancelled partial responses.
counterInterpretation.decimalMBps: Successful completed-object bytes divided by total probe wall time, including guard shutdown; not total link bandwidth.
counterInterpretation.retries: NativeSource recorded 62 retry increments. All 62 unfinished jobs ultimately failed because the memory guard closed the HTTP client. The counter was not sampled immediately before closure, so earlier connection failures cannot be separated from shutdown-related retries.
